segments: Keep the two most location-heavy parts of Love and War in one focused reference instead of burying them inside the main run.
After KRONOS, gather the full set and place the trophies into the Dragon Command challenge board.
Fire the Guard of Fafnir at the left of the two windows beside Double Tap so the blast hits the pipe behind it and ejects the trophy.
Shoot the trophy from the raised statue hand above the tank, then collect it where it falls below.
Place a Dragon Strike on the marked puddle to reveal the trophy.
Activate the giant laser trap and collect the trophy from the blasted floor after the trap finishes.
During the sewer ejection back toward spawn, shoot the red light until it turns green, then return to the Hatchery and collect the trophy from the toilet.
After earning the Gauntlet of Siegfried, release the Whelp at the locked safe, then heavy-melee/punch the safe with the Gauntlet to reveal the sixth trophy.
The first five challenge types can appear in a different order. The Group 935 keycard lockdown always comes last after those five are complete.
Each card gives you the objective and the one thing most likely to make the challenge fail.
Find the floating orb, damage it, follow its teleports, and repeat until it returns to Dragon Command.
The Pack-a-Punched Ray Gun Mark 3 makes the repeated damage windows much easier.
Watch the Dragon Command screen, memorize the flashed location order, then disable every terminal in that same order.
Write or screenshot the sequence before leaving Dragon Command if needed.
Find the green-eyed Mangler, break the correct shoulder armor, then walk him onto the Dragon Command circle without killing him.
Use a normal un-Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon for the shoulder shot and keep stray bullets away from the Mangler afterward.
Find the injured Valkyrie at the back of spawn and stay with it while it travels toward Dragon Command.
Avoid Widow’s Wine and Electric Cherry effects near the drone because accidental damage can fail the challenge.
Go to the location called out on screen, defend the Groph Module, then use the Gauntlet Whelp to collect its drop and return it to S.O.P.H.I.A.
The called-out module can be at Dragon Command, Tank Factory, or Supply Depot.
Take the keycard to the Hatchery computer, survive the Mangler lockdown while the download completes, retrieve the keycard, and return it to S.O.P.H.I.A.
This challenge always comes last after the other five are complete.
